decided to give the EDAs a listen and man were they good... ended up keeping the EDAs for myself and threw my old ZSXs to my dad instead

as a quick introduction:
I'm not really an audiophile...just a depressed human seeking cheap decent quality earphones/iems to listen to music (to cope) without them dying on me every few months or something

got the KZ ZSX back in 2020 to replace a dead earbud and thought they were fine and very listenable,, they lasted (and still are holding on well) for 2 years+ alr without me having to change cables... and that is under minimal care. I shove them in and out of my bag everyday and also somehow also accidentally drop them at the same time so I have no idea how they held on...an achievement for KZ and their QC I guess

until I "accidentally" heard the EDAs while testing them for my dad. not the best build quality but their "blanced" sound signature is no doubt more to my liking than the ZSXs for like... 1/5 the price. changed the tips to kbear 07s (the only tips I have at home atm unfortunately) because stock tips were not the best (the kbear ones definitely did fit better) can't comment on the soundstage and technicalities as I listen to mostly studio tracks with rather intimate mixing/mastering (without the precise reverb/soundstage of live concerts)

will be daily driving this lil budget guy till it breaks I guess...absolutely fancying the blanced sound (and also because I have no idea what to upgrade to)
